prototype_questions.question: Which persistence strategy best preserves inventory reservation correctness under high contention while remaining operationally reasonable for this codebase?
prototype_questions.rationale: The current optimistic-locking design is correct, but a future hotspot should be changed only if reproducible evidence shows a material advantage.

candidates.approach: Keep the existing optimistic @Version + bounded business-aware retry strategy and build a contention test/benchmark around it.
Prototype a pessimistic database write-lock strategy for the stock row and compare contention/failure behavior.
Prototype an atomic conditional SQL update/reservation operation that fails when available quantity is insufficient, while preserving the domain boundary.
